home.kicker: Ditšhono tsa ditheko tsa Aforika Borwa
home.headline: Kwa batlamedi ba SA ba kopanang le ditheko tsa nnete.
home.intro: Batla dithendara tsa setšhaba tse di tlhatlhobilweng ka go itirisa le di-RFQ ka intaseteri, porofense le letlha la go tswalela—ka dikgokagano tsa metswedi ya ntlha.
home.sourceNote: Ditšhono tsa setšhaba tse di bonweng mo manaaneng a semmuso a theko.
home.supplierBody: Batla ditshono. Netefadiwa. Godisa kgwebo ya gago.
home.smartScoreBody: E agilwe go tswa mo bosuping jo bo sekasekilweng jwa kobamelo le netefatso ya banka.
home.buyerBody: Motswedi o netefaditswe batlamedi ba ditirelo. Posa di-RFQ. Laola dinopolo.
home.trackedDaily: Theko ya setšhaba, e latedisiwa letsatsi le letsatsi
home.liveFeed: Phepo e e tswelelang, e seng senepe
home.statsBody: Ditšhono tsa ga jaana go tswa mo Dithenteng tsa semmuso tsa puso, tse di tlhatlhobiwang ka go itirisa go bona dikitsiso tse di phimotsweng kgotsa tse di setseng di abetswe.
home.network: Mafaratlhatlha a theko a Aforika Borwa a ntse a a emetse.
home.supplierPoint1: Kwala lenaane la kgwebo ya gago. Laisa nomoro ya gago ya CSD le setifikeiti sa B-BBEE.
home.supplierPoint2: Amogela SmartScore—tekanyetso ya gago ya go tshepa, e e bonalang mo moreking mongwe le mongwe.
home.supplierPoint3: Di RFQ tse di tshwanang di tla kwa go wena. Ga go tlhole go na le matlha a go tswalela a a fositsweng.
home.verified48: E netefaditswe mo diureng di le 48. Ga go na karata ya sekoloto.
home.smartScoreIntro: Motlamedi mongwe le mongwe o rwele SmartScore—e e tlhotlhomisitsweng kgatlhanong le metswedi e mene ya semmuso ya SA, e e sekasekilweng ke setlhopha sa rona.
home.smartScoreRank: Maduo a 90 kgotsa kwa godimo mme porofaele ya gago e tla nna kwa pele mo dipatlong tsa bareki.
home.buyerPoint1: Romela RFQ mo metsotsong e le metlhano. Seta tlhokego ya gago ya B-BBEE, porofense, le selekanyo sa boleng.
home.buyerPoint2: Batlamedi ba ba netefaditsweng ba itsisiwe ka bonako.
home.buyerPoint3: Bapisa ditsopolo ka go bapa—nngwe le nngwe e tshotse SmartScore le betšhe ya netefatso.
home.verifiedOrganisations: Bakeng sa mekgatlo e netefaditsweng. Bommasepala ba a amogela.
home.trustOfficialTitle: E Netefaditswe Kgatlhanong le Direkoto tsa Semmuso
home.trustOfficialBody: CSD, SARS, CIPC le bosupi jwa banka—bo sekasekilwe ke setlhopha sa rona pele ga fa moabi ope a tlhagelela.
home.trustMatchingTitle: Go Tshwantsha ga Intaseteri le Porofense
home.trustMatchingBody: Ditšhono tse di bulegileng di tshwantshanngwa le diporofaele tsa batlamedi ba ditirelo ke intaseteri e e kwadisitsweng le porofense.
home.trustNotificationsTitle: Dikitsiso tsa RFQ tse di tswelelang
home.trustNotificationsBody: Batlamedi ba tsibosiwa mo metsotsong e se kae fela morago ga gore go romelwe RFQ e e tshwanang.
home.trustAuditTitle: Direkoto tse di siametseng go tlhatlhobiwa
home.trustAuditBody: Nopolo nngwe le nngwe, awate, le kgwebisano di kwalwa le go romelwa kwa ntle go dira ditlhatlhobo tsa theko.
